reviews.text: Our two dogs absolutely love it here. Our 4 year old cavachon has always been timid and fearful of people but he wags his tail with excitement when he arrives and sees John. The place really is a godsend. We can holiday stress free knowing they're being exceptionally well cared for. Can't recommend the place enough

Earlier this year our dogs Ivy and Henry stayed with John. The care they got was exceptional. John sent photos and videos when we were away. When we collected them, they were nice and calm which tells me they enjoyed their stay for sure.  We are going away again next year and we have them booked in already in case Old Mill Kennels get booked out. Thanks a mill John. (Rita & Tom Cashman)
Have to say our pooch gets the best of care, plenty of play time and social time.  This has been his second time staying and he has come home happy and healthy .  Would highly recommend.

We left our two dogs with John for a week this August. While we were away John noticed that the older dog was listless and acted on it immediately and took her to the vet who had to perform a life saving operation on her. If it wasn’t for Johns quick thinking and action she would have been lost to us. Both dogs were so happy while they stayed in the kennels and were completely at home there . I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending Old Mills Kennels to anyone as we have found it to be the best place for our dogs

Chip goes to doggy day care and loves it he runs in every morning to join his friends 🐕🐾John is great with him, it is very well run and secure there and when we were on holidays last week John kept us updated with videos and photos I would have no hesitation in recommending Old Mill kennels

There is never a need to worry about Ziggy when she’s in Johns care at Old Mill Kennels. The facilities are spotless, the communication is excellent, she goes on lovely forest walks and we always have complete peace of mind while we are away. You can see John genuinely both loves and understands dogs.

Ziggy always comes home  happy, relaxed, and well looked after, which says everything. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend John to anyone looking for professional, caring, and reliable boarding.

We had our 6 month old puppy, Summer (a mini Goldendoodle), stay at Old Mill Kennels for 3 weeks while we were on vacation. We were absolutely thrilled with how Summer was looked after, she thrived under John’s care. Summer benefitted hugely from the supervised playtime she had with other dogs allowing her to be her best social self! John kept us up to date with photos and videos while we were away. 5 stars! Could not recommend Old Mill Kennels highly enough. We had a bad experience with a different kennel in the past so we understand how invaluable it is to be able to fully trust a kennel. Summer will be checking in for another boarding again shortly to see old friends and new!
Highly recommend
Great service ,and dog got best of care , lovely area for the dogs to stay
John has been great from the start with my puppy in doggy daycare. She loves it there and has completely gotten over her fear of other dogs. I can't recommend highly enough!

My dog Sandy has been going to the Old Mill Kennels over the past year. Initially during holidays and she loves it there and is always happy when she arrives and on collection.  I received regular update videos when away for longer breaks which was so reassuring.  She loves it so much I started sending her for day care a couple of days a week and she's so excited when she arrives.  Would highly recommend 🦮🐕‍🦺

Bella had a great time at Old Mill Kennels! We felt very happy leaving her there and she came home a very happy dog. We will definitely use John again and we delighted with John giving us update on Bella while we were away. Thanks John.
Have left my dog here 3 times now. She always loves it. They take really great care of her :)
Best Kennels in Cork, my dog Layla comes back so happy. Lovely location and good value

Old mill kennels is our dogs second home , so clean friendly spacious and comfortable. Our 2 dogs run in when I drop them off . John is an obvious dog lover and very kind . I can’t speak more highly of this kennels.
Great service from start till end of stay. John was very helpful in every step, photos and videos on request in no time. Will definitely recommend if you want your dog in good hands.

Can’t recommend the Old mill Kennel enough. Our dog daisy loves going there,she is excited to see John and is always happy when we arrive to collect. She is well looked after which is a big relief for us.

Amazing ! I've been going to John since we rescued our lurcher Lucky 2 years ago. Lucky loves it there.
Exceptional service,outstanding cleanliness and 💯% dependable and reliable. I cant recommend Old Mill Kennels enough. You're pet will be looked after like one of their own. Thanks John!

Old Mill Kennels is a family owned and run boarding kennel. It’s in such a lovely setting, with spotless facilities for dogs of all sizes. Our 11 year old Westie skips in and we can head away confident that he is being really well cared for John. We recommend without hesitation and will definitely be back!!

I couldn’t be happier with the care my dog received from John at the Old Mill Kennels. From the moment we arrived, it was clear how much the John genuinely cared about our dog Freddie. My dog was treated so well, with plenty of attention, love, and excellent care throughout the stay. I felt completely at ease knowing Freddie was in such safe and caring hands. I would highly recommend this kennel to anyone looking for a trustworthy and compassionate place for their dog—we will definitely be back!
My dog Kobe loves his stays at the kennel and John is great with the dogs. Would definitely recommend him and his kennel to anyone with large, Medium or small dogs.

Absolutely wonderful kennels. Used twice this year and my dog loves going to the old mill kennels. Very accommodating and takes great care of the dogs. Have recommended them to all friends and families

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We couldn’t recommend this kennel highly enough. It’s a caring, clean and ideal environment for dogs, and it gives us complete peace of mind when we’re away. John takes such good care of every dog and truly treats them as if they were his own. Our two dogs are always happy, relaxed and well looked after. Absolutely outstanding care.

John has been looking after our German Shepherd for the past few years and John has been exceptional to deal with from the start. He’s very caring for all canines which is clear to see. Very accommodating with any requests and our shepherd is always given the best care and attention when looked after.
Lovely kennels. Our sausage dog can be a little precious but she got on great. Was clearly well looked after. Will use this service again. Very happy

Have been leaving my German Shepherd with John for a number of years and would never leave her anywhere else. She is so happy and well cared for when I pick her up. Great indoor and outdoor area for all dogs.

I brought my dog Nell here, and I was genuinely impressed from start to finish. The staff treated her like family—gentle, patient, and so friendly that Nell settled in right away. The kennels were clean, bright, and well-kept, which gave me real peace of mind. When I came back to pick her up, Nell was calm, happy, and clearly had a great time. It’s obvious she felt safe and cared for. I couldn’t ask for a better experience, and this will definitely be Nell’s go-to place from now on.

I will NEVER bring my dog back to Old Mill Kennels. My dog was returned to me sad looking. His nice leash was ripped in two. His bedding was soaked and smelled of urine so bad I left it there. The conditions he was kept in must have been completely unacceptable and disgusting. My dog had to be washed thoroughly three times to clean the stench off of him. He was definitely not loved or properly cared for.
The facility looked nice when I dropped my dog off.
I was shocked at the condition my dog was picked up in.
Beautiful setting, my dog seems to love it.

We use this kennels anytime we need to head away as we know our dog is in good hands, hes always happy to stay with john, the kennels are spotless and the outside areas is brilliant for the dogs to have a play

Our Golden Retriever stayed in Old Mill Kennels for 8 days and absolutely loved his stay. We received regular contact from John to let us know how he was getting on and we picked up an extremely happy dog when we returned home! I can't recommend Old Mill Kennels and John highly enough!
Thanks a mill Shawn!

A colleague recommended the Old Mill kennels and we were so impressed by the professionalism, care, attention to detail, interest and enthusiasm of John that we will return as repeat customers. We got lots of video and photo updates which we wanted during our 10 days away. We were completely able to relax without worrying about our girls and happy in the knowledge they were being well looked after. Our two golden retrievers were really well taken care of , fed , watered, walked and had great fun on their own and mixing with other dogs. The kennels are secure , spotlessly clean and set in the heart of the country. I would highly recommend. Price wise , great value for money. ❤️
Great kennel my dog loves going there
Excellent care given to our dogs. First time user, will absolutely be using again
Thanks a mill!
Great set up, John is super helpful, the dog loved it. Would recommend.

John is a wonderful person who takes good care of the dogs he cares for. My 6 month old collie puppy was very anxious about interaction with other dogs, and we were worried for him too. His first experience with another kennel wasn’t great. John really made him feel so comfortable, that there can be times now that my up may rather wants to stay back than come back home with me 🙄😅My pup looks forward to being back at the kennel. It is like a home away from home for my baby collie who is now 8 months plus.

Selkie stayed for three days. She was happy and calm at the kennels, and when I picked her up, she was her usual bubbly self. The Kennels' setup is professional and spotless, and all communication with John was clear and helpful. I recommend Old Mills Kennels and will happily trust them to take care of my girl again.

Our golden retriever stayed at the old mill for 10 days in July (2024). John was absolutely fantastic and Bolt had such a great time. The whole set up is so professional and John gave me some great tips on feeding Bolt. We didn't worry about Bolt at all while we were away. Bolt made lots of friends and was reluctant to come home. Will definitely be using the Old Mill for every holiday.⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent dog kennels, my two dogs have stayed a couple of times and I would highly recommend

John offered a very professional service. Oscar was very happy there although it was his first visit. He is a nervous dog but he was happy out there.
The facilities are spotless there. …
Easily the best run kennels in Cork. Brandy gives it 5 stars!

Very nice man..plenty of undates
Would recommend to anyone
We were  happy  to have John  care for our dog and found his kennels to be of a great  standard,  would  highly recommend the old mill  kennels.

We would highly recommend Old Mill Kennels if you are looking for a top class kennel for your dog. It is truly home from home, our dog Bob loved staying there as John has a real way and love for animals.

Delighted to recommend Old Mill Kennels who took great care of our dog, making her feel safe and welcome during her stay. John sent photos and videos regularly keeping us up to date and seeing our dog happily playing was such a comfort. We …
